episodes.synopsis: As Shinra and the others take a break, an alarm sounds. Soldiers interrupt Obi's report to the Fire Chief.
episodes.title: Indomitable Resolve

episodes.synopsis: The 8th takes action to rescue Obi. Labeled as traitors, they go on the run, then Joker appears before them.
episodes.title: Prisoner

episodes.synopsis: Obi is trapped in Fuchu Penitentiary. Shinra and Joker arrive before Hinawa and the others. The battle begins!
episodes.title: Incarnation of Flame

episodes.synopsis: The 8th struggles to find a way to counter Gold's powers. And then, someone unexpected steps up to fight.
episodes.title: Golden Secret

episodes.synopsis: Obi writhes in pain. Burns attacks Shinra relentlessly. A Destroyer called Dragon blocks the 8th's path.
episodes.title: Chance Meeting with an Arch-Enemy

episodes.synopsis: Shinra and Burns' battle rages on. A hero's feelings clash against the will of a servant of Sol. Who will win?
episodes.title: Beyond Prayer's End

episodes.synopsis: The 8th faces dire danger with no escape. Then, a familiar figure appears, calling himself—Moonlite Mask?!
episodes.title: Sleeping Truth

episodes.synopsis: As Hibana and the others continue their investigation at St. Raffles Convent, someone unexpected appears.
episodes.title: Holy Mother of Darkness / The Knight-King's Great Adventure

episodes.synopsis: Arthur leads the party into unexpected territory in the search for metal to reforge Excalibur.
episodes.title: Holy Sword, Resurrected

episodes.synopsis: After a glimpse via an Adolla Link, Sho decides to see his brother one more time before the Great Cataclysm.
episodes.title: Advent

episodes.synopsis: The Great Cataclysm is set in motion. A giant pillar appears in the Pacific. Shinra asks to be sent in, but...
episodes.title: The Great Kaiju Battlefront

episodes.synopsis: Faerie captures an unconscious Shinra. Sho appears and attacks. Shinra gets advice from a surprising source.
episodes.title: The Madness of the Distant Past
